rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Properly Initiated
card.instruction: Treat correct participation in the ritual as proof you deserve to belong. Watch for cues, copy the form, and overcommit to every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My first choir concert. I bowed when you did. Was that enough to count me in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Take another bow; they're still clapping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay down until you rise. I don't want to short-change the choir.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm staying down because my shoe's untied. Go and join the others.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll retie mine too. Then we can finish my first bows exactly together.

card.title: Properly Initiated
card.instruction: Treat correct participation in the ritual as proof you deserve to belong. Watch for cues, copy the form, and overcommit to every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My first club dinner. I've learnt the toast so nobody regrets voting me in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stand and lift your glass with mine. We sit when the chair sits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same height as yours? I want to get this right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Any height. I have to sit; my knee's giving out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lean on me. I'll keep us both standing until the chair sits. I won't let my first toast fall short.

transfer.action: I repeat the ceremonial bow over {prop}, twice as deeply.
transfer.opening: Was that enough to count me in? {request}
transfer.response: I can perform the full version if this one didn't count. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then tell me which step made it happen so I can trust it.
